review_candidates.title: Integration Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Title Integration Manager Job Description Do you like to manage internal and external stakeholders, organize and conduct tests on system level? Do you like to take an extra step, analyzing the root cause of a failed test, and initiating the process to decide on solutions for this cause? And lastly, do you like to travel, meet many cultures, and see places? Then apply now as an Integration Manager in our APAC project integration department. Vanderlande understands the complexities associated with operating a successful airport and parcel operation and delivers future proof logistic process automation. These automation systems are composed of many (electro-) mechanical and IT components, built by teams in various parts of the world, and must be integrated with other (software) systems to support the processes of our customers. Your position The Integration Manager is part of the management of an airport and parcel project. Working closely with a project manager and project leaders of the various hardware- and software engineering disciplines, he or she focuses on the design, integration and testing of the system with special attention to managing the technical risks that are inherent to complex systems. The Key Tasks And Responsibilities Of The Integration Manager Manage the functional design to ensure customer requirements are translated into the right solution with the lowest possible risks. Advise on the use of standard solutions and the impact of special solutions Identify risks and find solutions to reduce them Realize the system integration plan, test plans and test specifications in collaboration with the Solution Architect and Integration Engineer (s) Manage the test phase and ensure a smooth, seamless transition to our customers' operational processes together with the Integration Engineer and other engineering disciplines. Understand the customer processes and act as an advisor in correctly estimating the impact of changes Progress monitoring with clear, concise reporting Managing component deliveries by suppliers by means of verification and validation Integrating (sub-)systems in existing customer systems Make sure that the system, after a careful testing phase, is handed over according to specification by your colleagues and suppliers. Your department The APAC project integration department is part of the business unit Airport & Parcel Solutions within Vanderlande Industries. The department is responsible for system design, testing, and integration of complex Airport and Parcel systems for customers in the Asia Pacific region, such as Changi, Hong Kong, and Western Sydney Airport, and DHL and FedEx international customers. The department works in an international team setting with people from different countries with different cultural backgrounds. Your profile You have a technical or logistics education, at least Bachelor level or Master level Preferably, you are familiar with customer processes in Airport or Parcel Automation You are an experienced system integrator and are familiar with systems engineering processes (requirement management, verification and validation, change management and configuration management) You know how to build partnerships with customers and with internal and external suppliers You know how to find the right balance between quality, lead time and cost You have well-developed analytical skills, and you think at system level You are proactive and pragmatic You are able to motivate people at all levels and are a team builder. You have good communication skills in English (written and verbal) You’re willing to travel for about 50% of your time, working on-site in the project handover phase Diversity & inclusion Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

review_candidates.description: Title Information Manager - Systems Integration KBR is a global provider of differentiated, professional services and technologies delivered across a wide government, defense and industrial base. Drawing from its rich 100-year history and culture of innovation and mission focus, KBR creates sustainable value by combining engineering, technical and scientific expertise with its full life cycle capabilities to help our clients meet their most pressing challenges today and into the future. We deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in over 29 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. At KBR, We Deliver. KBR is looking for an Information Manager - Systems Integration to work in our Leatherhead offices. The IM Systems role is responsible for the setup, management, and operation of interfaces between engineering applications such as SMARTPLANT and AVEVA authoring tools, engineering databases and Digital Twin technology. The role ensures that data is correctly shared, consistent, accurate, and includes the administration of data repositories where the project engineering and supplier data is stored and maintained. It involves receiving or performing data transfers, managing changes, and generating reports and to ensure effective exchange and handover of a complete dataset to the Client for the operations phase. Development and maintenance of project tag numbering schema, Class Libraries, production of deliverables, reporting and data progress measurement. Key Activities Plan, direct, co-ordinate and be the focal point for data management systems integration. Facilitate the setup and configuration of the data repositories to meet the project requirements. Understand corporate and project requirements for data collection, conditioning, reporting and handover. Working knowledge, understanding and expertise in AVEVA and Hexagon toolsets as follows: Configuration of data entry tables (grids) Data access controls. Data import, export, transform and load. Reports. Tag management. Automation. Class Library Admin level support to define and configure Class Libraries Configuring and AVEVA ISM to manage class library. Define tag format, list of values, unit of measure etc. Manage transfer of Class Library data into engineering database and Digital Twin environment. Understand complex regular expression. Setup and ensure compliance with Data Standards Define project reports, summary and business intelligence dashboards. Coordinates with project disciplines to resolve any data inconsistencies, errors or mapping issues associated with interfaces. Experience, Education, Skills & Job Knowledge University degree qualification or equivalent oil and gas industry experience. A relevant number years of experience in an engineering data systems role. Experience of using and managing Engineering Data Warehouses such as AVEVA Engineering, SMARTPLANT Foundation or similar. Experience of using and managing engineering class libraries using AVEVA Information Standards Manager or similar. IT Skills – Excellent working knowledge of databases and reporting A good technical background in Oracle 12c, PL\SQL, ETL and data warehousing. Expertise with writing and optimising Oracle/SQL stored procedures and query performance. Automation of processes using different scripting languages like PowerShell, CMD etc. Strong design and system architecture skills Designing and implementing new business logic / reports as SQL inside stored procedures within the existing system / reporting framework, as well as enhancing and maintaining existing functionality Self-sufficient and be creative in defining reporting/data solutions. A strong background with the Microsoft BI stack (SSIS, SSRS, Power BI). Knowledge of AVEVA Net, AIM and Engage or similar. Knowledge of CFIHOS. KBR Company Information When you become part of the KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through collaboration with our customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the solutions and services to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to total safety and reliability. At KBR, we partner with government and industry clients to provide purposeful and comprehensive solutions with an emphasis on efficiency and safety. With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis. Working at KBR means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services. As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution. review_candidates.title: Customer Success & Delivery Manager
review_candidates.description: About Eno Health Eno Health is an AI-powered platform designed to be the ultimate decision-support system for healthcare providers seeking to facilitate personalised care and long-term wellness for patients. We are building a compliant, secure, and European-sovereign biomedical AI solution for personalised healthcare. The platform streamlines practitioners' workflows and patient data processing, enabling faster, more precise clinical decisions. Role Description Eno Health not only reaches patients directly but also improves their health through professionals and partners: functional-medicine practitioners and clinics that use Eno Health's AI Platform as their biomedical backbone to bring their patient base onto the platform; laboratories whose results flow into it; and data partners whose integrations feed it. You will own those relationships from signed agreement onward, through go-live and into steady state. Delivery gets a partner live; success keeps them active, growing, and renewing. This role is both, deliberately: in a B2B2C model, a practitioner who goes quiet is churn for their entire patient base, so the person who onboards them is also the person accountable for their ongoing health. Today that motion is founder-led and bespoke. Your job is to turn it into a repeatable delivery machine: a clinic onboarded in days, not weeks; a laboratory integration that follows a playbook rather than a project; and the first reference customers whose experience sells the next ten. As we open new markets, you will be the person who makes market entry and execution an exercise, running the same playbook with local partners rather than reinventing delivery in each country. This is a hands-on role that fuses two disciplines usually split across departments: implementation delivery and customer success. You will not write code, but you will live one conversation away from the people who do. You will be fluent enough in the platform's data flows to scope an integration honestly and say no to one that isn't ready. You will run multiple implementations in parallel while carrying the live base: leading practitioner onboarding, chairing lab-integration calls, running review and check-in cadences with active practices, spotting the account that has gone quiet before it churns, unblocking issues between partner technical teams and our engineers, and reporting delivery and account-health status the founders can act on. Expect direct customer contact daily, in Dutch and English at minimum. You will also feel the texture of an early-stage company: some weeks you are building the playbook, other weeks you are the playbook. This is a full-time hybrid role based in the Brussels Metropolitan Area, with flexibility for remote work. Qualifications A track record of owning B2B implementation or delivery end-to-end in health tech, SaaS, diagnostics, or another domain where go-live has real operational stakes, and from kickoff through go-live to steady state. Customer-success craft alongside delivery: you have owned a portfolio of live accounts, run health-scoring and adoption metrics, designed intervention plays for at-risk accounts, and can show the retention or expansion numbers you moved. Renewal-mindedness is core to this role, not an adjacent skill. The relationship instinct that underpins both is that you build trust that survives a rough go-live, you hear the concern behind the question, and customers pick up the phone to you before they escalate. Technical fluency without an engineering title: you can read an API specification, follow a data-flow diagram, and hold your own in an integration scoping call. Familiarity with health data exchange (HL7/FHIR, lab result formats) is a strong advantage. Structured project management as a habit: plans with owners and dates, risk logs that get read, status reporting that is honest before it is polished. Method-agnostic; discipline non-negotiable. Customer-facing excellence with professional audiences: you have managed implementations for demanding, expert customers, as clinicians especially value someone who respects their time and their competence. Process-building experience: you have taken a bespoke, founder-led, or ad hoc motion and turned it into a documented, measurable, transferable playbook. Comfort with regulated environments: you understand why some steps cannot be shortcut, and can explain that to a customer without hiding behind "compliance says no." Laboratory, diagnostics, or LIMS-adjacent delivery experience: you have onboarded labs or clinical data providers before and know where those projects actually stall. Experience in practitioner-led or clinic-channel commercial models, such as B2B2C health, dental, veterinary, or allied-health platforms. International rollout experience: delivering the same solution across markets with local partners. Account-expansion experience in a B2B2C or channel model: growing an account's end-user base, upsell motions with professional customers, or community-building among practitioner networks. Familiarity with medical-device or quality-managed delivery contexts (ISO 13485 environments). Professional fluency in Dutch and English; proficiency in French or Arabic is a strong advantage for our markets. What We Offer The chance to design a delivery function from zero at the moment it becomes the company's growth engine. Competitive salary and an equity package. Hybrid working from our Brussels base, with flexibility for remote work and occasional travel to the UAE. Direct collaboration with the CEO, CPO and founding team.
